title: docs: re-fence the complex, disclosure, layout, navigation and overlay remainder of objectui#5867 as ts, 31 blocks across 31 component pages (batch 8)
body:
Refs #5867 (batch 8)
Clause-②: no. A docs fence-language and compile pass; no contract or accept set moves.

Batch 8 of objectui#5867's lane, the last five subgroups of the components remainder. Every TypeScript block that triage's classifier reads as code under `content/docs/components/{complex,disclosure,layout,navigation,overlay}/**` was fenced `plaintext`, so `check-doc-snippet-types` never compiled it. All 31 of them are now fenced `ts`. 24 then failed to compile, all on one name, and each is fixed in the block itself. None is marked as a fragment, and no component type or gate logic moved.

Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`

## Population, re-measured on `main` `5262f7dd3`

Measured with `node scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs --list` (the gate's own walk and triage's classifier). The whole remainder on `main` was 72 blocks in 72 files. The five subgroups hold **31 blocks in 31 files**, and the batch takes all of them. Neither excluded page (`basic/text.mdx`, `form/file-upload.mdx`) is in these subgroups.

| subgroup | before (blocks / files) | re-fenced `ts` | red on first compile (TS2304 `SchemaNode` only) | after |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| complex | 9 / 9 | 9 | 4: `carousel`, `resizable`, `scroll-area`, `view-switcher` | 0 |
| disclosure | 3 / 3 | 3 | 2: `accordion`, `collapsible` | 0 |
| layout | 8 / 8 | 8 | 8: all eight | 0 |
| navigation | 1 / 1 | 1 | 1: `header-bar` | 0 |
| overlay | 10 / 10 | 10 | 9: all but `menubar` | 0 |
| **total** | **31 / 31** | **31** | **24** (59 diagnostics, all TS2304 `SchemaNode`) | **0** |

The handover predicted about 25 red, with `ReactNode` in `complex/data-table.mdx`. That did not reproduce. The block in the population is the `TableColumn` / `DataTableSchema` listing, and it compiles untouched. The page's other `plaintext` fence, which ends in `ReactNode`, opens `renderCellEditor?: (ctx: {`. The classifier reads that as prose, so it was never in the population and is not in this batch.

These figures are readings at the heads named below. The live number is that `--list`, and nothing re-derives this table.

All 31 blocks are self-declared `interface` listings, so they belong to the separate #6143 own-interface count. The compile now proves that every member type resolves. It does not judge the member rows against the shipped schema; the three `@object-ui/types` doc pins below still do that for the overlay pages.

## The fix, 24 times

Each red block used `SchemaNode` without declaring it. Each now opens with `import type { SchemaNode } from '@object-ui/types';`, which is what `layout/box.mdx` and batch 7's `list.mdx` / `empty.mdx` already do. The import is the block's first line, and triage's classifier reads `import`, so if one of these blocks is ever fenced `plaintext` again the fence gate still flags it. The ablation below measures exactly that.

## `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES`: 31 rows deleted, none added

This follows the card's standing rule (authorisation comment 5905984416): a batch deletes the zero-count rows of its own re-fenced pages. `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` has 0 lines added and 31 deleted, every one a map row. No number was raised and the gate logic is untouched. The deleted rows, all under `content/docs/components/`:

- `complex/`: `carousel`, `data-table`, `filter-builder`, `filter-ui`, `resizable`, `scroll-area`, `sort-ui`, `table`, `view-switcher` (9)
- `disclosure/`: `accordion`, `collapsible`, `toggle-group` (3)
- `layout/`: `aspect-ratio`, `card`, `container`, `flex`, `grid`, `page`, `stack`, `tabs` (8)
- `navigation/`: `header-bar` (1)
- `overlay/`: `alert-dialog`, `context-menu`, `dialog`, `drawer`, `dropdown-menu`, `hover-card`, `menubar`, `popover`, `sheet`, `tooltip` (10)

Each row is the page's `.mdx` with a count of 1. The map goes from 72 rows to 41 on `main`.

## The doc-pin readers, re-pointed with no assertion change

The three `packages/types/src/__tests__` readers batch 7 named extract an overlay page's interface from its schema fence by regex. All three threw once the fence became `ts`: `Test Files 3 failed | 1 passed (4)`, every failure `expected exactly one plaintext fence in ..., found 0`. `filter-builder-mirror-6939.test.ts` also reads a page in this batch (`complex/filter-builder.mdx`), but it locates `interface X {` across the whole page. It is fence-agnostic and stayed green.

- `alert-dialog-read-dialect-7104.test.ts` and `overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts`: `schemaFence` now reads the page's one `ts` fence. Every page they read is in this batch.
- `overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts` takes batch 7's per-subject fence language (`Subject.fence`). The header, `schemaFence`, the `Subject` field, the call site and the counter-probe use **the same text PR #11341 introduced**. The only difference from #11341's version of the file is the six `SUBJECTS` values: the five overlay subjects are `ts`. `EmptySchema` stays `plaintext` here, because on `main` `feedback/empty.mdx` is still plaintext until #11341 lands.
- The one `expect(` line touched is the counter-probe's call, which gains the fence argument exactly as in #11341. Its assertion (`toThrow(/found 2/)`) is unchanged.

Because these tests sit under `packages/types/src`, `check-changeset-presence` counts them as published source and goes red without a changeset (measured: exit 1, naming the three files). `.changeset/5867-plaintext-fenced-ts-batch8.md` therefore has an **empty frontmatter**, so nothing is released. No `skip-changeset` label is applied.

## Serial with PR #11341 (batch 7)

At this PR's opening, #11341 is still an open draft (head `1f9701afc`) and `main` has not moved from `5262f7dd3`, so the pre-PR `git merge origin/main` was a no-op (`Already up to date.`). A dry run, `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against #11341's head, shows exactly two conflicts. Both are mechanical, and everything else merges cleanly:

1. **`scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`, the map:** keep both sides' deletions. The map then holds exactly two rows: `content/docs/components/basic/text.mdx` and `content/docs/components/form/file-upload.mdx`, the two excluded pages.
2. **`overlay-node-slot-doc-types-7082.test.ts`, the `SUBJECTS` block:** set all six subjects to `fence: 'ts'`.

Once #11341 lands, this branch merges `main` (merge, never rebase) with that resolution, and the gates re-run on the new head.

- **Build:** `turbo run build` over the snippet gate's own `--build-filter` closure, `--concurrency=2`: `Tasks: 35 successful, 35 total`, VERDICT command-exit 0. The filter re-derived at the final head is byte-identical (md5 equal), so the closure did not move.

- **Round 1** (`fb370a45`, re-fence only): exit 1, `729 to compile`, `729 of 729 block(s) judged, 24 failed.` All 59 diagnostics were `TS2304: Cannot find name 'SchemaNode'`, across exactly the 24 files in the table.
- **Snippet gate after** (`77e90204`): exit 0, `245 covered (160 of them hold a ts/tsx block), 4 ungated`, `Covered blocks: 885 — 729 to compile, 156 declared fragment(s).`, `Syntax phase: every block parsed`, `729 of 729 block(s) judged, 0 failed.`, `Every covered documentation snippet compiles against the built types.`
  - Deltas: to-compile +31, exactly the batch. Documents holding a `ts` block +31. Covered, ungated and fragments are unchanged.
- **Fence gate:** `--self-test` gave `26 cases pass`. The run gave exit 0, `41 declared file(s) carrying 41 block(s)` (base: 72 / 72).
- **Other gates, each exit 0:**

  - `check:doc-example-ids`: `414 real reference(s) all resolve`

  - `check:docs-route-closure`

  - `check:control-bytes`: `OK (scanned 9806 tracked text file(s); skipped 85 binary)`. A grep self-scan of the 36 changed files found 0 control bytes.
  - `check:new-line-citations`: `0 new citation(s)`
  - `check-changeset-presence`: `declares 1 changeset(s)`, EMPTY frontmatter

- **Tests, run from the repo root with `vitest --maxWorkers=2`:**
  - The readers of these pages are the union of `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --list` (the `content/docs/**` and `content/docs/components/**` readers, plus the named overlay and filter-builder readers) and a `git grep` for the five subgroup paths. That union is 21 files: `Test Files 21 passed (21)`, `Tests 1001 passed (1001)`.
  - `vitest run scripts/__tests__/` (the fence script's own test file plus every scripts test that greps its name): `Test Files 177 passed | 2 skipped (179)`, `Tests 5371 passed | 2 skipped (5373)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (`tsc --noEmit`, then `tsconfig.examples.json`, then `tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0 with 0 `error TS`. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes all three edited tests.
- **Lint narrowing:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 36 changed files gives 36 results.
  - 32 are `File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied` (31 `.mdx`, 1 `.md`). `eslint.config.js` matches `ts`/`tsx` plus the default JavaScript set.
  - 4 are linted (the three tests and `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`), with 0 errors and 2 warnings. Both warnings are `no-explicit-any` on an untouched pre-existing line of `overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts`; the same line is present at base.
  - `eslint.config.js` configures no `project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Ablation: one fixed block re-fenced `plaintext`

The fix was committed first. The tool was objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode, with an EXIT/INT/TERM restore on the absolute path. The target was `overlay/dialog.mdx`, one of the import-fixed blocks. The anchor `` ```ts `` went x1 to x0, `` ```plaintext `` went x0 to x1, and the blob changed (`742584d2` to `6b0085f6`). On-disk counts taken while mutated were 0 / 1.

- **Predicted:** `check:doc-fences` red, one block beyond the baseline naming `dialog.mdx`; `check:doc-snippets` green but one block fewer.
- **Observed:** `check:doc-fences` exit 1: `1 TypeScript block(s) under an unhighlighted fence, beyond the baseline: content/docs/components/overlay/dialog.mdx:12 ```plaintext — import type { SchemaNode } from '@object-ui/types';`. `check:doc-snippets` exit 0 with `728 to compile` and `0 failed`. That is the silent hole the fence gate closes.
- **Restore proven:** the blob after restore equals HEAD (`742584d2`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Not measured

- **Site render:** no site build was run. The re-fenced blocks go through the same highlighter as the `ts` fences these pages' siblings already render.
- **External link check (lychee):** CI-only workflow.
- **The merged tree with #11341:** that PR has not landed. Only the conflict shape was computed (the dry run above); the gates are owed again on the merged head.
- **`e2e/docs-smoke.spec.ts`** (Playwright) and the full `pnpm test`: CI-owned.

## Acceptance notes

- **After #11341 lands and this merges,** `KNOWN_UNHIGHLIGHTED_TS_FENCES` holds only the two excluded rows (`basic/text.mdx`, PR #11069 parked; `form/file-upload.mdx`, its own labelled line). That is the whole of the card's remaining fence debt.
- **Observation, not filed (carrier: none).** `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` does not record `overlay-trigger-union-7081.test.ts` as a reader of the overlay pages. The test builds its path from a template (`${DOCS}/${type}.mdx`), so the scanner never makes it a candidate, and `--audit` passes. It has no effect today: `content/docs/**` is already a recorded input, so `--changed` answers non-empty for any of these pages and CI takes the full run.
- **Brief note:** the dispatch's gate list expected "no changeset is owed", while its binding ruling ordered the empty-frontmatter changeset. The presence gate is red without one (measured above), so the ruling holds.
